# `aitbc contract messaging-messages`

List messages in a forum topic.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc contract messaging-messages [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--topic-id` | text | — | yes | Topic slug |
| `--limit` | integer | `50` | no | Max messages to return |
| `--offset` | integer | `0` | no | Offset for pagination |
| `--sort-by` | text | `timestamp` | no | Sort field (default: timestamp) |
| `--rpc-url` | text | `http://localhost:8202` | no | Blockchain RPC URL <!-- check-ports: ignore --> |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc contract messaging-messages --topic-id <topic_id>
RPC_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8202/rpc
aitbc contract messaging-messages --topic-id <topic_id> --rpc-url "$RPC_URL"
```
